gloss: outstanding versatility; working on all fronts

definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is active and effective in many areas at once, handling multiple tasks or roles with great energy. Literally 'eight faces and six arms,' evoking a Buddhist deity capable of looking and reaching in all directions simultaneously.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八面六臂|はちめんろっぴ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She was remarkably active on all fronts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少人数|しょうにんずう}→少人数：12465_shouninzuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{八面六臂|はちめんろっぴ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: In a small team, everyone is expected to work versatilely on all fronts.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立|た}ち{上|あ}げで、⟦マネージャー→マネージャー：29755_maneejaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八面六臂|はちめんろっぴ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: During the launch of the new project, the manager showed outstanding versatility.

notes:
A four-character idiom (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) from Buddhist imagery. {八面|はちめん} (eight faces) represents awareness in all directions, and {六臂|ろっぴ} (six arms) represents the ability to act in many ways at once, like the multi-armed deity ⟦{阿修羅|あしゅら}→阿修羅：26334_ashura⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {八面六臂|はちめんろっぴ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧: outstanding all-around performance
- {八面六臂|はちめんろっぴ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧: versatile work on many fronts
- {八面六臂|はちめんろっぴ}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: display of versatility

USAGE:
Almost always used in the pattern {八面六臂|はちめんろっぴ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧ to praise someone's energetic and wide-ranging efforts. It is a compliment, often used in written or formal speech. Rarely used for oneself.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}→縦横無尽：14074_juuoumujin⟧: freely and without restraint — emphasizes unrestricted movement rather than multi-tasking
- {獅子奮迅|ししふんじん}: fighting with the ferocity of a lion — emphasizes intensity rather than breadth
